title: Compliance Manual: Settlement Agreements Letters, Delivery Channel and Required Disclosures
content:
# Settlement Agreements — Letters and Disclosures

**§1 Writing.** Every settlement under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements is in writing.

**§2 Timing.** The offer letter is sent within the programme's offer-letter time in business days after the offer date; the acceptance confirmation within the programme's acceptance-letter time in business days after acceptance and, where the programme requires it, before the first settlement payment is taken; and the default notice within the programme's default-notice time in business days after a default.

**§3 Status.** Settlement letters are sent only for a settlement whose status is offered, accepted or defaulted.

**§4 Once per type.** Each letter type — offer letter, acceptance confirmation, default notice — is sent once per settlement.

**§5 Channel.** The offer letter goes by email only where the programme allows email delivery of the offer letter and the consumer's profile carries an email address; every other letter goes by the channel the offer letter used.

**§6 Time-barred disclosure.** Every letter on an account whose statute-of-limitations expiry date is before the letter date carries the time-barred terms, stating that the debt is too old to be sued on, where the programme requires the time-barred disclosure; all others carry the standard terms.

**§7 Tax notice.** The acceptance confirmation carries the cancelled-debt tax notice when the balance at offer less the settlement amount is at or above the programme's tax-notice threshold; no other letter carries it.

## Decision grid for §5–§7

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Offer letter, programme allows email, profile has an email address | email |
| Offer letter, programme does not allow email, or no email address on the profile | mail |
| Acceptance confirmation or default notice | the channel the offer letter used |
| Statute-of-limitations expiry date before the letter date, disclosure required | time-barred terms |
| Expiry date on or after the letter date | standard terms |
| Acceptance confirmation, amount waived at or above the threshold | tax notice included |
| Offer letter or default notice | no tax notice |

## Hypothetical case

Balance at offer 1500.00 dollars, settlement amount 840.00 dollars, a 600.00-dollar threshold: 660.00 dollars is waived, so the acceptance confirmation carries the tax notice; the offer letter for the same settlement does not.
